en: Figure... it out! Grah! I can feel my stomach eating itself... Well, you know what they say, "hunger is the best seasoning." But damn... why'd I have to find out like this?
All right, I get it. I'll zip back as quick as I can. Don't die on me.
Please... hurry.
Okay, okay! Ya made your point! Just let us go!
You know I can't do that.
Sure ya can! We're, uh, ready to turn over a new leaf! Start fresh! ...Pinky promise?
Well, when the cops get here, you can pinky promise them⑬maybe even cry on their shoulder. After all, what's a couple felonies between friends, right?
Shit... We're screwed!
We appreciate your cooperation. Thanks to you, we've finally shut this trafficking ring down. The seven foreign nationals involved have been taken into protection.
Were all of them tricked into coming to Japan and... forced to work on the streets?
It would appear so. In some countries, local mobsters are known to approach families in poor areas and promise them stable jobs abroad.
It's a serious ongoing problem. But this time we have a solid testimony, thanks to the scum you apprehended. Gives us a better chance to close the book on this for good.
Thank you so much! Now we all go home!
Really, I am grateful. Please, take.
You got a <Color:8>Cherry Tree Branch<Color:Default>.
You are very brave... You saved everyone!

To be honest. All I did was stumble into a lady who I
thought could use a crisp, refreshing vitamin drink. That's
about all I could offer someone working through a cold.
About that...
I'm sorry, but I lie about the cold.
They told us police were their allies. That police even worse with punishment. So we had no one.
I wanted to find Japanese person I could trust. Someone with kind heart who listen.
So I pretend to be sick. To see if nice person come along and help me.
Ahhh, so that's what you were up to. Heh, you sure reeled me in. Hope you're happy with your big catch.
I thought everyone in this country was rotten... but not you. Thank you for being different. For reaching out to me.
I not forget you when I go back home. Thank you... and goodbye.
Come on, big daddy. Let's make it a night to remember! *hack* *wheeze*

Yeah, I got that, but ya keep talkin' in circles! When're ya
gonna tell me the damn price! You even Japanese? Sheesh...
At least ya got beauty on your side. But brains? Doubt it.
Uh. Sorry to interrupt, but I need to talk to her a sec.
Huh? Who said ya could cut in line? Didn't ya learn to wait your turn in grade school!?
No, man, that's not it. She's got a cold. I just brought her something to help pick her up.
Oh? This for me?
What? She's sick!? Ugh, I'm keeping my hands to myself, thank you very much. You take your <Italic>germ party</Italic> elsewhere!
Look, I just fine. I not cough on you, do I? Wait, please! Ah... Atchoo!

Yeah, you are totally under the weather. I really think you
should go home, but if I'm being too overbearing, then here.
Try drinking this⑬it might just do the trick.
That kind of you to offer, but I no can drink.
(She must really have an awful cold. I guess she can't handle much more than a vitamin drink at this point.)
<Italic>Gahack-hack!</Italic>
(I need to find her an vitamin drink from somewhere.)
You handed over a <Color:8>Toughness Z<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Toughness ZZ<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Toughness Emperor<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Toughness Infinity<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Tauriner<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Tauriner +<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Tauriner ++<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Tauriner Maximum<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Staminan X<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Staminan XX<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Staminan Royale<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Staminan Spark<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Staminan Light<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Toughness Light<Color:Default>.
...Thank you. You a really good guy.
Ah, it's no big deal. Just trying to help.
My name is Sara. This the first time Japanese person treat me so nice.
So, want to party? I give you the extra-sexy service. One-time offer?
That's very sweet of you, but maybe when you're not coughing and sneezing everywhere. By the way, is there some reason you have to keep at it like this?
I get in trouble if I'm not working. He get angry... then I get hurt.
You mean your employer hits you? For taking time off, even when you're sick? That's insane!
Hey, you! What's the big idea?

You just ran that trick off, ya dang goof! We were watchin'
the whole time! Ya tryin' to mess with our business!?
I'm⑬I'm sorry, what?
They always watching, making sure we work. You need to go now. Run. Be safe!

You ain't going nowhere, pal! You owe us for that client
your dumb ass drove off!
But all I did was get her something to drink. Can't you see she's sick?
Well that cost us business, ya shithead! Now shut your piehole and pay up, or we'll knock your own teeth down your throat!
It's 15,000 yen to play, so we'll let ya off with a penalty of 30,000. Fork it over before your hospital bill gets any worse.
How about no? Oh, and she tells me you hit her? That's a terrible way to treat your workers.
Fuck off. These bitches owe us for bringing their sorry asses into the country. Until they pay us off, we can do with 'em whatever we want.
They're in debt?
They lie to us! They say there good jobs in Japan, but tell us nothing about debt!
When we come, they take our passports. Now we no can go outside unless it to work. We never have moment to ourselves!
You shut your trap, wench! If it ain't "me love you long time," then "me don't wanna hear it"!
You people are morally deficient, taking advantage of girls who are just trying to earn a better life. Wait till the cops hear about this.
No! They say police are their friends. If we go to them, they send us back. Things only get worse.
Nobody here help us...
The only way that's possible is if they bribed the entire force.
Well, I highly doubt that's the case. These clowns don't carry that kind of weight, in paper or in stature.
Hey! Yes the hell we do!
Psh. You might be able to con someone who just got here, but I know better. Our boys in blue would never let you get away with this.
In fact, let's give 'em a call. Shouldn't be a problem. After all, they're buddy-buddy with you, right?
Wait! Could ya... not do that? Uh... for the sake of convenience!
Wow. You guys are a disgrace⑬to men, to Japan, and to <Italic>Homo sapiens</Italic> in general.
Why don't ya take your condescending attitude and shove it up your cornhole! Better yet, we'll do it for ya!
Hey, big boy. Want to party? I give you a real nice time.
(Hm? Is she... a foreigner? Don't see too many in Nagoya, that's for sure.)
Come on. Don't be shy. Party with me, I make you feel sexy all night. And don't worry⑬I affordable.
I'm flattered, but I'm also flat broke. Maybe we can party some other time.
Aww, you sure? *cough* *cough* Urff...
<Italic>Gahack-hack-hack-hack!</Italic> *wheeze*
Whoa! I've never seen a cough that bad... You're not all right, are you?
It... the winter over here. Japan freezing, but it always hot where I'm from. Ugh... I don't feel good.
Maybe you caught something standing out here in the cold? You should be home and in bed.
Can't. *sniffle* I get in trouble if I not working... <Italic>Gahack-gahack!</Italic>
Look, you're in no state to be working. In fact, you should be seeing a doctor.
Doctors ask for money. That mean I have to work.
Well, what about taking some medicine? Don't you have some?
Medicine? There are too many. I can't... *sniffle* read... Ah-Ah-<Italic>Atchoo!</Italic> *sniff* Excuse me. I can't read label.
(I can't just stand by and watch. The least I could do is offer her a vitamin drink to help her get through the night.)
*cough* *choke* *wheeze* So... cold. But... must work...
(I can't just stand by and watch. The least I could do is offer her an vitamin drink to help her get through the night.)
The day's finally done. I deserve to knock one back on the way home.
Where ya from? Nagasugai's got a lot of places you can visit. Take the long way 'round and explore.
Man, I thought Fukuoka was in the sunny south, but it's just as cold as everywhere else.
Hello! Please drop in and check out Club SEGA.
There's a club on Nagasu Boulevard called La Seine. There's a girl there named Riku-chan. She's dynamite. Ba-ba-boom!
Hey, there! Lookin' for some of the cutest girls you've ever seen? Come on in!
Do I treat myself to a bowl of real southern ramen before heading back to Tokyo, or save the money? So tempting!
Hey, buddy! Got hotties here waitin' for you! Come on in and get acquainted!
Not from around here? So where are you from? If you're visitin', you should know Nagoya's famous for the food. Enjoy your stay!
I can't stop myself. I try and try again to stop eating tebasaki chicken wings, but how could I? They're just so good!
Rice miso's good. So is wheat miso. But when you're in Nagoya, hatcho miso is the one. Try some miso-stewed udon and see what I mean.
Can I interest you in a game of pool?
Hey, watch where you're going!
Ow! Aniki, I... I think my shoulder's dislocated!
But I barely...
(This scam again... The victim looks kind of familiar, though.)
Oh man, that's a complex break in his arm for sure. How are you going to make this right?
His arm? But... I bumped into his shoulder.
Don't give me that shit. You must've bumped into him so hard, you broke them both!
Oof... Aniki, he messed up my leg, too!
Hang in there. I'll call a taxi to take us to the hospital!
Okay, fatcakes, cough it up! We're gonna need 100,000 yen for the taxi and the hospital!
(Better help him out.)
Huh? What the hell do you want?
Aren't you a little old to be pulling petty shakedowns like this?
Hey, you mind, pops? I have to get to the hospital, so back the fuck off.
You look perfectly fine to me.
Hey, guys, let's cut pops here some slack.
After all, I think what he's saying is that he wants to pay up instead of fatty fatkins here.
Show me the money!
You guys just don't get it. I guess I'll have to teach you a lesson in honesty.
Now, if you really want to go to the hospital, I'd be happy to send you there.
No, please!
I never wanted to actually break any bones!
We're really sorry!
You all right?
Thank you. I... Kiryu-san? Is that you?
Wait a second...
It's me, Kamiyama. You know, the guy who mods stuff over in Kamurocho?
(Oh, right, Kamiyama. The weapons guy.)
(But no, I can't let him know it's me. You never know who might be listening.)
You've got the wrong guy. The name's Suzuki.
Suzuki-san, right? Would you mind coming by my shop?
Your shop?
Yes. You see, in addition to Kamurocho and Downtown Ryukyu, I've also set up shop in Nagasugai.
I'm sure someone like you will find something useful there. So how about it Kiry⑬ I mean, Suzuki-san?
(Kamiyama's shop might prove useful if trouble comes looking for me. Hope I don't have to use it.)
All right, lead the way.
Heh... Hehe. Right this way, Suzuki-san.
There you are, Kazuma Kiryu. I found you at last. Or is it Taichi Suzuki you're calling yourself now?
I'm Ren Higashino. I'm in the qualifiers for the Victory Road.
I see. So you're the one spreading rumors about me.
I didn't mean to blow your cover, but it's a bit late for apologies now, I guess. I never expected to find you in a town like this.
I saw you fighting in Kamurocho once. The power you displayed motivated me to up my game. Now you owe me a chance to test my mettle.
I don't see why I owe you anything.
You made me into what I am today, Kazuma Kiryu.
What if I said you've got the wrong guy?
There are plenty of others like me out there, you know! You think you can run from all of us!?
Don't try to tell me you're not who I think you are. I know how to find out.
I can't let you run off without giving me a shot. I don't care if you're game or not.
You lit a fire in me... and now it's time to stoke it!
Man... You sure live up to your reputation!
Excellent performance, "Suzuki-san." Shall we assume this means you are willing to take part in the Victory Road competition?
